Sales Development Representative – Americas

Location: North America, Central America, South America, or the Caribbean (Remote) Type: Full-Time Level: Entry to Mid

Join Pumpfiat as a Sales Development Representative and help bring ethical, permission-based outreach to fast-growing businesses across the Americas. We are looking for candidates based in North America, Central America, South America, or the Caribbean to strengthen our understanding of regional markets and drive outreach.

Apply Now
← Back to all Pumpfiat careers

About the Role

You’ll be on the front lines of Pumpfiat’s growth, prospecting and qualifying leads through outbound email and LinkedIn outreach. Your mission is to book demos for high-value clients while demonstrating the power of compliant, high-performance campaigns.

Why the Americas matter to us: We want to build authentic relationships with businesses across North America, Central America, South America, and the Caribbean, understand local market nuances, and tailor our outreach effectively.

This is a fully remote role for candidates based in countries across North America, Central America, South America, and the Caribbean.

Key Responsibilities

  • • Research and identify high-potential prospects using Pumpfiat datasets and tools.
  • • Craft personalized outbound sequences (email + LinkedIn) that drive replies and bookings.
  • • Qualify inbound leads and schedule demos for the sales team.
  • • Meet and exceed monthly targets for qualified opportunities and pipeline generated.
  • • Collaborate with marketing to test new messaging and channels.
  • • Contribute local market insights from across the Americas to refine targeting and messaging.

What We’re Looking For

  • • 1–3 years of SDR, sales, or outbound prospecting experience (SaaS/tech preferred).
  • • Proven ability to write compelling cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
  • • Comfortable with tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar.
  • • Strong research skills and attention to personalization.
  • • Resilience, coachability, and a metrics-driven mindset.
  • • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • • Based in a country in North America, Central America, South America, or the Caribbean.

Nice to Have

  • • Experience selling into or working within startup ecosystems across the Americas.
  • • Fluency in additional languages used across the Americas.
  • • Track record of over-achieving quota.
